info.title: Event API
info.description:
## Why use the" Events API?

The Events API enables your application or service to track analytic
events and click stream data from your touchpoints. These events can
range from user events to device or signal events.

## What you shouldn't use Events API for?

The Events API is meant to model user driven events that are based
on users performing actions. It is not meant for operational events
or tracking events that are more system and CPU and hardware related.
-----

post.summary: Log an application-level event for the user.
post.description:
This endpoint records an application-level event that a user has experienced. It captures important analytics data to help track user interactions with the app. Use this to enhance user experience and improve engagement through targeted notifications.

👤 User Credential: You must login and authenticate a user and use their access token to invoke this service. This will operate the action under the specified user.

get.summary: Retrieve user-specific location events in order.
get.description:
Fetches the user's location events sorted from the most recent to the oldest. This endpoint is designed for user access to their own location data, ensuring privacy and security. Ideal for tracking user movements and analytics related to location events.

👤 User Credential: You must login and authenticate a user and use their access token to invoke this service. This will operate the action under the specified user.

🔒 Consent: location.places.read is required in order for the call to succeed. Ensure that you have the consent approval for the user or this call will fail.

post.summary: Record user location event for tracking.
post.description:
Records a location event for the authenticated user. This API allows users to securely log their location information for tracking and analytics purposes. It ensures that only authorized users can access and submit their location data.

👤 User Credential: You must login and authenticate a user and use their access token to invoke this service. This will operate the action under the specified user.

🔒 Consent: location.places.write is required in order for the call to succeed. Ensure that you have the consent approval for the user or this call will fail.

delete.description:
This endpoint allows the current user to delete their location event records. It ensures that only the authenticated user can manage their own location data, maintaining privacy and security. Use this operation to remove unwanted location history associated with your account.

👤 User Credential: You must login and authenticate a user and use their access token to invoke this service. This will operate the action under the specified user.

🔒 Consent: location.places.write is required in order for the call to succeed. Ensure that you have the consent approval for the user or this call will fail.
